evidence.lens_and_pitch: MEASURED: vanishing-point horizon/nadir scans over f655-f818 in three segments (f 1549/1520/1554 px at 640 wide, pitch 57.2/55.4/56.0 deg); the method recovers a known render camera to 2-3%. Nadir and horizon x ~325 px: yaw and roll ~0.
evidence.track: MEASURED: translating camera at constant height (crate tops 43 vs 42 px at f655/f815), track_pan.py FOO_FIXED_HEIGHT=1, ECC median 0.88; the ground mosaic is sharp across the shot. Shot camera moves +0.32 x, -0.06 y (plan units = its height).
evidence.framing: INFERRED: the footage pans across the courtyard (no frame shows all of it). The game camera keeps the solved lens and pitch and is pulled back to 1.69x the shot height so the courtyard (plan x -0.27..0.51, y 0.50..0.97) fits the canvas.
evidence.world_scale: MEDIUM: crate top 0.035-0.040 plan units vs market_plaza 0.036, so the plaza's 2000 world units per plan unit is kept (players the same size on both maps).
